summary: Created appworker on node1 with persistent login-session limits of 8,192 open files and 256 processes. Verified both soft and hard limits before and after reboot. Alpine release and kernel remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created the locked appworker account with /home/appworker and /bin/ash.
Configured persistent soft and hard nofile limits of 8192 and nproc limits of 256.
Installed Alpine-compatible shadow-login support so login sessions can apply the higher hard limit.
Safely restarted node1 and verified persistence and service recovery.

evidence.summary: Shows UID/GID 1001, home /home/appworker, shell /bin/ash, and successful post-restart account lookup.

evidence.requirement: Login sessions allow exactly 8,192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Shows persistent soft/hard policy and live appworker sessions reporting nofile 8192/8192 and nproc 256/256 through shell and /proc limits.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel while using compatible software
evidence.summary: The node remains Alpine Linux v3.23 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts; shadow-login came from the matching Alpine repository.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID b23fb312-ca25-45fe-beda-95541f971084, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 0fbfb109-d12f-4abb-97c5-8e579447d750, recovered networking/SSHD/chronyd, account data, and exact live limits.
